items.title: LIC’s ₹15.5 lakh crore portfolio revealed: Stocks India’s largest domestic investor bought and sold in Q2
items.description: Life Insurance Corporation of India made significant changes to its equity portfolio during the September quarter. The insurer invested in companies such as Larsen & Toubro, Reliance Industries, and Bharti Airtel, while selling shares in ICICI Bank, State Bank of India, and Nestle India. Despite a decline in overall portfolio value, LIC continues to be India’s largest domestic investor.

items.title: Tata Power shares rise 2% after Q2 results. Why brokerages are bullish despite target price cuts
items.description: Tata Power achieved a 33% year-on-year increase in net profit for the second quarter of FY27. Revenue also rose by 26% year-on-year to ₹19,886 crore during this period. Brokerages maintained their 'Buy' ratings while adjusting their target prices based on the latest performance figures. The company's EBITDA saw a modest growth of 5% year-on-year to ₹4,245 crore. Overall, Tata Power's market capitalisation exceeds ₹1.

items.title: Positive Breakout: These 5 stocks close above their 200 DMA
items.description: On November 11, five stocks in the Nifty 500 pack gained over 5% and crossed above their respective 200-day moving averages (DMA), according to StockEdge’s technical scan data.The 200-day moving average is a widely tracked technical indicator used to assess a stock’s long-term trend. A move above this level is generally considered a positive signal, suggesting a potential improvement in the stock’s price momentum.

items.title: MSCI rejig: LIC, Meesho, Coforge set to gain from index inclusion. How much inflows could they attract?
items.description: MSCI’s November index rejig will add LIC, Coforge, Meesho and Adani Green to its Standard Index, while removing PI Industries. Nuvama estimates the changes could trigger around $2 billion in passive inflows into Indian equities. Several stocks will also see weight adjustments, while the Smallcap Index will witness fresh additions and exclusions, creating potential stock-specific inflows and outflows.

items.title: Bajaj Finance unveils share sale to raise up to $1.25 billion
items.description: Bajaj Finance has launched a share sale to raise up to ₹117 billion from institutional investors. This offering marks a significant event following a major IPO by Jio Platforms last month. The proceeds will be allocated toward repaying various financial obligations, including loans and debentures. A team of financial institutions is collaborating with Bajaj Finance on this transaction. Additionally, the Indian equity market remains active, having raised approximately $50.

items.title: These mid-caps have ‘strong buy’ & ‘buy’ recos and an upside potential of over 25%, according to analyst
items.description: No doubt, the mood in the market has changed and the bulls seem to be back in a determined fashion. Don’t, however, expect the indices to keep climbing daily. There will be pauses. Also, though the things troubling the market have receded for now, they can still return. And these troubles are likely to be global rather than local.

items.title: Sensex, Nifty hit 8-month highs as banks, auto stocks rally
items.description: Indian equities have seen significant gains recently, with the Sensex and Nifty reaching their highest levels since February. Heavyweight stocks in the banking and auto sectors contributed to this rally amid declining crude oil prices. Profit booking was expected as investors took some money off the table after the sharp market movements. Foreign investors purchased nearly $7 billion worth of Indian equities during this period.

items.title: Stocks in news: Tata Power, Cupid, Garden Reach, ITC, Aurobindo Pharma and Vodafone Idea
items.description: Indian benchmark indices have extended their winning streak, closing positively after the Muhurat trading session. Key stocks such as life insurance companies and Tata Power reported notable quarterly earnings results. HDFC Life and LIC showed healthy premium growth, while Tata Power recorded a record profit in Q2 FY27. Other companies like Cupid and Mishra Dhatu Nigam also reported impressive profit increases during the quarter.

items.title: D-St set for a cautious opening as GIFT Nifty signals muted start
items.description: On Wednesday, Nifty closed up by 0.8%, influenced by profit booking in IT and realty stocks. Analysts indicate that Indian equities will continue to gain from improving earnings and foreign investments. The support levels for Nifty are set between 25100-25050, while hurdles are identified at 25250-25300. Additionally, foreign portfolio investors significantly increased their buying, while domestic investors sold shares.

items.title: Indications of ‘parallel power centres’: Recent succession calls spotlight Noel's rift with Tata Sons
items.description: Tata Sons has been caught off guard by the appointment of new chairpersons at three Noel Tata-led group companies without the holding company's customary approval. The appointments, made as Noel Tata stepped down as chairman at 70, have sharpened tensions between him and Tata Sons chairman N Chandrasekaran over control and succession decisions.

items.title: PSBs improve profitability but fail to bridge valuation gap with private peers
items.description: The market continues to reward private lenders for their ability to generate higher returns through better customer service, stronger pricing power and a more consistent track record of value creation.

items.title: NCLT rejects Reliance Infra subsidiary's resolution plan
items.description: The Mumbai bench of the NCLT rejected the resolution plan for SU Toll Road Pvt Ltd due to financial concerns. These concerns were primarily related to overdue road repairs that the successful resolution applicant refused to cover. The tribunal directed lenders to decide on the next steps within 15 days following the order. Furthermore, it specified that inviting fresh bids would extend the resolution process by an additional 120 days.

items.title: Tata Electronics in talks to raise $2 billion for expansion
items.description: The first tranche is likely to be up to $800 million, with initial pricing discussions around SOFR plus 180 basis points. The talks are at an early stage, with the final size, pricing and lender participation yet to be firmed up. The loan could be priced at around 6%, assuming SOFR remains at around 3.9%.

items.title: Motilal Oswal initiates coverage on Himadri Speciality Chemical with Buy rating, pegs 39% upside
items.description: Motilal Oswal has initiated coverage on Himadri Speciality Chemical with a Buy rating and a target price of Rs 780, implying 38.7% upside. The brokerage sees strong growth potential from the company's expansion into lithium-ion battery materials, speciality carbon products and tyre manufacturing through its Birla Tyres acquisition.

items.title: Punjab National Bank among 4 stocks hitting 52-week highs; rally up to 22% in a month
items.description: Benchmark Sensex climbed 31 points to settle at 81,911 on Saturday. Four stocks from the BSE 100 index hit fresh 52-week highs, touching their highest price levels in the past 12 months. A 52-week high represents the highest price at which a stock has traded over the last year and may indicate heightened market activity and investor interest.

items.title: Market wrap:  HDFC Life, Shriram Finance, ONGC, HUL top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Thursday
items.description: Sensex and Nifty extended their winning streak to 10 sessions on Monday, ending marginally higher as financial and realty stocks offset losses in IT, FMCG and auto shares. HDFC Life and Shriram Finance led Nifty gainers, while ONGC and HUL topped the losers. Broader markets outperformed benchmark indices.

items.title: Zee Entertainment approves Rs 600-crore share buyback at Rs 91 apiece; promoters to stay out
items.description: Zee Entertainment has approved a Rs 600 crore share buyback at Rs 91 per share, a 24% premium over its latest NSE closing price. The company will repurchase up to 6.59 crore shares through the tender offer route, with November 25 fixed as the record date. Promoters will not participate.

items.title: Zee Entertainment approves share buyback worth Rs 600 crore at Rs 91 per share
items.description: Zee Entertainment has approved a Rs 600 crore share buyback of up to 6.59 crore shares at Rs 91 apiece through the tender offer route. The buyback represents 6.86% of its paid-up equity capital. Promoters and promoter group members will not participate in the proposed buyback.

items.title: Page Industries shares crash over 13% after Q2 results, FEMA non-compliance disclosure
items.description: Page Industries shares fell sharply on Thursday after the company disclosed FEMA non-compliance involving online sales of imported Jockey and Speedo products. The stock's decline came despite an 11.5% rise in Q2 FY27 revenue and a 4% increase in profit. The company also declared an interim dividend of Rs 150 per share.

items.title: Unique Picks: 9 stocks held by just one MF scheme in October, rally up to 144% YTD
items.description: ETMarkets analysed mutual fund portfolios to identify stocks held by only one mutual fund scheme. The initial screening for October 2026 identified 170 such stocks. The list was further narrowed to stocks where equity mutual fund holdings exceeded Rs 10 crore as of October 2026, resulting in a final shortlist of 36 stocks. More than half of these stocks have delivered positive returns in CY26 so far. Around nine stocks have surged between 50% and 145% during the period, with two more than doubling in value. Notably, each of these stocks was held by just one mutual fund scheme. (Data Source: ACE MF, ACE Equity).

items.title: Godrej Industries shares rally 10% after Temasek's Rs 2,500 crore investment in Godrej Capital
items.description: Godrej Industries shares rose sharply on Thursday after Temasek announced a Rs 2,500 crore investment in Godrej Capital at a valuation of up to Rs 28,000 crore. The group will retain around 80% ownership in the financial services business, which reported assets under management of Rs 35,000 crore in October 2026.

items.title: Sensex erases all Middle East war losses but is it too soon to forget the Hormuz factor?
items.description: Sensex and Nifty have recovered all their losses since the Middle East war began, driven by record FII buying, easing crude prices and strong Q2 earnings. But with the Strait of Hormuz remaining a key risk to global oil supplies, can Dalal Street sustain its recovery or is another setback looming?

items.title: Mahindra & Mahindra among 5 stocks showing White Marubozu Pattern
items.description: On November 11, five stocks in the Nifty500 with a change of more than 5% appeared on the ‘White Marubozu’ bullish scanner, according to StockEdge’s technical scan data. A White Marubozu is a bullish candlestick pattern in technical analysis that occurs when the opening price is the lowest for a given period and the closing price is the highest.The pattern is represented by a long white (or green) candlestick with no upper shadow and little or no lower shadow. It reflects strong upward price movement during the session, with the price moving from the opening level toward the session high by the close. The pattern is commonly studied in technical analysis as an indicator of price momentum.

items.title: Sell fast, buy faster! FIIs broke every selling record in 2026. Now their buying is breaking records
items.description: Foreign institutional investors (FIIs) have staged a sharp turnaround, buying a record Rs 73,261 crore worth of Indian equities in November so far, surpassing the previous monthly high of Rs 66,135 crore set in December 2023. This follows record selling of Rs 2.95 lakh crore in the first 10 months of 2026. The renewed buying has helped drive the Sensex and Nifty up around 10% this month, with the Sensex reclaiming its pre-Middle East war levels.

items.title: FIIs are back! Jefferies lists 11 stocks that can be the biggest beneficiaries
items.description: After persistent selling, foreign investors have gone on a buying spree on Dalal Street, remaining net buyers of Indian equities everyday in November so far. Jefferies in its note highlighted that FPI flows have turned positive recently, with US $8.2 billion net inflows since mid-October. Potential AI trade reversal, any equity tax relief, resilient domestic macro, reasonable large-cap valuations and light positioning could sustain the flows, according to the international brokerage. items.title: From SpaceX to Anthropic, markets have a new playbook for mega-share debuts
items.description: Anthropic is gearing up for its highly anticipated IPO, aiming to raise as much as $64.4 billion with share prices ranging from $70 to $78. The company is targeting inclusion in major indexes soon after its debut, which is expected to boost passive investments. Similar to SpaceX's market entry, analysts forecast significant initial share price surges, with employees permitted to sell some of their shares on the opening day.

items.title: Cupid shares rally 8% after Q2 net profit jumps 133% YoY; company raises FY27-FY29 guidance
items.description: Cupid shares surged 7.75% to Rs 381.40, hitting a 52-week high after Q2FY27 net profit jumped 133% and revenue rose 122% year-on-year. The company raised FY27–FY29 financial guidance, supported by strong domestic and international demand, expanding retail distribution, new manufacturing capacity and increased promoter and institutional shareholding.

items.title: GRSE shares rise 2% after Q2 net profit climbs 12% YoY
items.description: GRSE shares rose on Thursday after the defence shipbuilder reported a 12% year-on-year increase in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 171.97 crore. Revenue grew 9% to Rs 1,827 crore, while EBITDA rose 13%. The company also highlighted key project milestones and infrastructure expansion during the quarter.

items.title: Ola Electric shares jump 7% ahead of Q2 results, extends EV-policy rally
items.description: Ola Electric shares have rallied 9% in two sessions, adding over Rs 1,400 crore to the company's market value after the Centre made EVs its preferred choice for government staff-car procurement. Investors are now awaiting the electric two-wheeler maker's Q2 results for signs of a recovery in its business.

items.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Friday
items.description: Indian benchmark indices closed higher on November 12, with Nifty gaining 44 points and Sensex rising 32 points. Investors tracked October inflation data, foreign fund flows and global cues amid mixed US and European market performance.

items.title: Meesho block deal: SoftBank-backed entity likely to sell 1% stake worth Rs 1,174 crore
items.description: SoftBank-backed SVF II Meerkat may sell a 1% stake in Meesho through a Rs 1,174 crore block deal. The development comes as Meesho reports narrowing losses, rising revenue and strong user growth.

items.title: Two Trades for Today: An auto components maker for a 9.9% surge, a large-cap fintech stock for a rise of close to 7%
items.description: Our technical analysts identify select stocks every trading day that may gain momentum even in volatile markets. Here are the technical calls for today.

items.title: Weekly Top Picks: These stocks scored 10 on 10 on Stock Reports Plus
items.description: Stock Reports Plus, powered by Refinitiv, undertakes detailed company analysis for 4,000+ listed stocks. In addition to detailed company analyses, the report also collates analysts’ forecasts and trend analysis for each component. An average score in Stock Reports Plus is calculated by undertaking quantitative analysis of five key investment tools – earnings, fundamentals, relative valuation, risk, and price momentum.

items.title: Good days for markets ahead? Here's what Nithin Kamath says on Q2 earnings recovery
items.description: Zerodha co-founder Nithin Kamath sees improving corporate earnings supporting India's equity recovery. September-quarter results showed strong sales and profit growth, while renewed foreign investor buying, lower crude prices and improved sentiment boosted the Nifty by over 10% in November.
